title: Secret scan (gitleaks)
summary: Scans full git history for committed secrets with a pinned gitleaks binary and a generic allowlist.
notes: Ships non-blocking (gitleaks --exit-code 0) so the first run is a clean signal, not a wall. After the first clean report, flip the scan step to blocking by removing --exit-code 0. The gitleaks binary is version- + sha256-pinned; bump both together from the gitleaks releases page.
